items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The interviewee identifies Matt Perez's son, but the mention of 'Dodge' (Matt Perez's brother) is made solely by the Interviewer. The Interviewee does not confirm knowing Dodge personally, only acknowledging the family connection mentioned by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: That's Matt Perez's son. Yeah, that's Matt Perez's son.
He's in California now. Yes, that's right. He's brother Dodge, you know, who played trumpet. Yeah. Yeah, that's the one I met at Chicago.
I remember that in that first time.
